blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Earth observation (EO) workflows require selecting among known outcomes, estimating confidence, and processing large volumes of imagery. Generative vision-language models can address these tasks, but autoregressive decoding is computationally costly and their confidence estimates are unreliable. Decision models offer an alternative, returning probabilities over candidate answers in a single forward pass. However, their accuracy, calibration, and transfer across EO tasks remain insufficiently understood. We investigate these properties through a diagnostic study of d3-flash (8.4B parameters) across 30 settings from 23 public EO benchmarks. We find that compositional reasoning transfers well and calibration improves over its Qwen3.5-9B backbone on 24 settings, while counting, change quantification, damage grading, and absent-object recognition remain challenging. To address these limitations, we adapt d3-flash through low-rank fine-tuning on public EO training splits, producing EO-Jev. EO-Jev improves significantly over d3-flash on 26 of 30 settings and matches or exceeds specialist references on 20 of 28. It also achieves an average gain of 8.0 points across 12 held-out settings and lower expected calibration error than specialists on 21 of 28 settings. These improvements come at a modest cost of 1.8 points in general decision performance. Our results demonstrate the potential of adapting general decision models into competitive EO generalists while highlighting persistent challenges in quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 地球观测工作流程要求在已知结果中作出选择,估计信心并处理大量图像。 基因视觉语言模型可以解决这些任务,但自旋解码在计算上成本高昂,其信心估计不可靠. 决策模式提供了另一种选择,在一次前行通行证中,对候选人的回答有回归概率。 然而,它们之间的准确性、校准和跨道德操守办公室任务的转移仍然不够了解。 我们通过对23个公共道德操守办公室基准中30个环境的d3-flash(8.4B参数)的诊断研究来调查这些属性. 我们发现,在24个设置上,组成推理的转移和校正比Quen3.5-9B主干要好,而计数、改变量化、损害分级和缺失对象识别则仍然具有挑战性。 为解决这些局限性,我们通过对公共道德操守办公室培训的分拆进行低级微调来调整d3-flash,生成了EO-Jev. EO-Jev在30个设置中的26个设置比d3-flash大为改进,在28个设置中的20个设置上匹配或超过专家参考. 它还在12个搁置设置中实现了平均8.0分的增益,比在28个设置中21个设置中的专家更低的预期校正误差. 这些改进在一般决策业绩方面花费了1.8分。 我们的结果显示,在分配转变的情况下,将一般决定模式调整为竞争性的道德操守办公室通才具有潜力,同时强调在定量认知、选择顺序一致性和校准方面持续存在的挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as general-purpose interfaces to EO imagery, answering questions about land use, objects, change and disasters that previously required a dedicated model per task ( Kuckreja et al., 2023 ; Soni et al., 2024 ; Pang et al., 2024 ; Irvin et al., 2024 ; Shabbir et al., 2025 ) . A new class of models pushes this interface in a different direction. Decision models , popularized by Jev ( TypeSafe AI, 2026 ) and its open counterparts ( AutoTrust, 2026 ; vLLM Semantic Router Team, 2026 ) , do not generate text. Rather, given a state, a question and a set of options, they return a probability distribution over the options in a single forward pass. For EO applications such as damage triage, monitoring and alerting, this is an attractive capability as an answer that comes with a trustworthy confidence can be thresholded, aggregated and audited, as illustrated in Figure 1 , whereas free-form text generated auto-regressively cannot.
blocks.zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用作EO图像的通用界面,回答关于土地使用、物体、变化和灾害的问题,这些问题以前需要每个任务一个专门的模型(Kuckreja等,2023;Soni等,2024;Pang等,2024;Irvin等,2024;Shabbir等,2025)。 新一类的模型将这个接口推向了不同的方向. 由Jev(TypeSafe AI,2026年)及其开口对应方(AutoTrust,2026年;vLLM语义路由器团队,2026年)所普及的决定模型不生成文本. 相反,鉴于一个状态、一个问题和一组选项,它们会在一次前传中返回对选项的概率分布。 对于EO应用,如损害分解、监测和警报,这是一种具有吸引力的能力,因为如图1所示,这种能力具有可信赖的信心,可以进行阈值、汇总和审计,而自由形式的文本则不能自动递归。

blocks.en: Yet no general decision model has been evaluated on remote-sensing data. The public decision-model leaderboards do not contain EO imagery ( Decision Index contributors, 2026 ) . The closest prior work is RSJEV ( Si et al., 2026 ) , which applies a one-pass decision readout to scene classification using Qwen3.5-0.8B and reports encouraging results on UC Merced, AID, and NWPU-RESISC45. However, it trains and evaluates separately on each benchmark, and its results are not directly comparable with out-of-domain evaluations. Moreover, an independent study shows that letter-readout classifiers can collapse across label vocabularies and confidently misclassify unseen classes ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . Therefore, it remains unclear whether a general decision model can perform reliably across EO tasks, how it compares with specialist VLMs, and whether its confidence estimates can be trusted. We address these questions across ten capability groups, with out-of-domain evaluation, EO specialist baselines, and calibration analysis.
blocks.zh: 然而,还没有对遥感数据的一般决定模式进行评价。 公共决策模式领导板不包含EO图像(决策索引贡献者,2026年). 前作中最接近的作品是RSJEV(Si等,2026年),采用一通读取决定来进行场景分类,使用Quen3.5-0.8B并报告UC Merced,AID,和NWPU-RESISC45上的结果令人鼓舞. 然而,它就每个基准分别进行训练和评价,其结果与外地评价不具有直接可比性。 此外,一项独立研究表明,信读出分类器可能会在标签词汇上崩溃,并自信地将隐形分类(Chen等人,2026年). 因此,一般决定模式是否能够可靠地完成道德操守办公室的任务,如何与专家的自愿核查和清单相比较,以及其信任估计是否可信,仍然不清楚。 我们处理10个能力小组的这些问题,包括外地评价、道德操守办公室专家基线和校准分析。

blocks.en: In this study, we first conduct a diagnostic study of d3-flash ( vLLM Semantic Router Team, 2026 ) , an open state-of-the-art 8.4B-parameter decision model derived from Qwen3.5-9B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . We construct 30 closed-form evaluation settings from 23 public benchmarks, covering scene recognition ( Yang and Newsam, 2010 ; Xia et al., 2017 ; Cheng et al., 2017 ; Helber et al., 2019 ) , multi-label land cover ( Clasen et al., 2024 ) , visual question answering ( Lobry et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , counting ( Xia et al., 2018 ; Cheng et al., 2014 ) , change and temporal reasoning ( Yuan et al., 2022 ; Xuan et al., 2025 ) , disaster assessment ( Gupta et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , geo-localization ( Christie et al., 2018 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , complex reasoning ( An et al., 2024 ; Muhtar et al., 2024 ; Danish et al., 2024 ) , and questions about absent objects ( Pang et al., 2024 ) . The evaluation primarily focuses on optical aerial/satellite imagery. To reduce differences arising from benchmark protocols, we evaluate d3-flash, its Qwen3.5-9B backbone, and selected open-weight EO specialist baselines on identical images, questions, and candidate answers. The backbone uses a comparable answer-code readout, allowing us to examine the effects of decision training under a common evaluation interface.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们首先对d3-flash(vLLM语义路由器团队,2026年)进行了诊断性研究,这是从Quen3.5-9B(Quen Team,2026年)衍生出的一个开放式的8.4B参数决定模型. 我们从23个公共基准中构建了30个封闭式评价设置,涵盖场景识别(Yang and Newsam,2010;Xia等,2017;Cheng等,2017;Helber等,2019),多标签地覆盖(Classen等,2024),视觉问题回答(Lobry等,2020;Li等,2024),计数. (夏等,2018;程等,2014.),变化与时间推理 (袁等,2022.;X等,2025.),灾害评估 (古普塔等,2019.;王等,2025.b.),地缘定位. (Christie等人,2018年;周等,2024年),复杂的推理(An等,2024年;Muhtar等,2024年;丹麦等,2024年),和关于缺席对象的问题(Pang等,2024年). 评价主要侧重于光学航空/卫星图像。 为了减少基准协议所产生的差异,我们评价d3-flash,它的Quen3.5-9B主干线,以及选定相同图像、问题和候选答案的开放加权EO专家基线。 骨干采用可比较的解码读取,使我们能够在共同评价界面下审查决策培训的效果。

blocks.en: We then investigate how EO-specific supervision changes the decision model capabilities identified by this analysis. Using low-rank adaptation on public EO training splits, together with general decision-data replay, we obtain EO-Jev . The name denotes an EO adaptation of the Jev-style decision interface i.e., a single model that returns probabilities over task-specific candidate answers without autoregressive decoding. We distinguish evaluation settings whose datasets contribute training data during adaptation from settings whose datasets are held out entirely from that stage. This allows us to assess improvements within the adaptation datasets alongside transfer to other datasets. We also examine calibration, option-order sensitivity, inference cost, and retention of general decision capabilities to avoid catastrophic forgetting.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们调查具体道德操守办公室的监督如何改变本分析确定的决策模型能力。 使用低级的适应 公共EO培训拆分, 加上一般的决定数据重放, 名称表示对Jev风格决定界面的EO调整,即一个单一模式,在不自发地解码的情况下返回对任务特定候选人答案的概率. 我们把数据集在适应期间有助于培训数据的评价设置与数据集完全从该阶段产生的设置区分开来。 这使得我们可以评估适应数据集内的改进情况,同时将数据转移到其他数据集。 我们还审查校准、选择顺序敏感性、推论成本和保留一般决策能力,以避免灾难性的遗忘。

blocks.en: The study addresses four main questions. (RQ1) Which EO capabilities transfer from a general-purpose decision model without EO-specific adaptation, and how does its performance compare with EO specialists? (RQ2) How does EO supervision affect performance, and do its benefits extend to datasets held out from adaptation? (RQ3) How do calibration and inference cost compare with the backbone and specialist baselines? (RQ4) Which limitations persist after decision model adaptation to EO tasks?
blocks.zh: 这项研究涉及四个主要问题。 (RQ1) 哪些EO能力在不采用EO特定调整的情况下从普通用途决策模型中转移,其性能如何与EO专家相比? (RQ2) 道德操守办公室的监督如何影响业绩,其好处是否扩大到适应措施所保留的数据集? (RQ3) 校准和推断成本如何与主干线和专家基线相比较? (RQ4) 在决策模式适应道德操守办公室任务之后,哪些限制仍然存在?

blocks.en: Our results show that d3-flash performs well on several compositional EO reasoning benchmarks and achieves lower expected calibration error than its backbone on 80% of the cases (24 out of 30 settings). Its principal weaknesses are counting, change quantification, damage grading, and recognizing absent objects. EO adaptation improves performance significantly on 26 settings (86.7% cases), with mean gains of + + 23.8 percentage points on settings from datasets used during adaptation and + + 8.0 points on settings from held-out datasets. EO-Jev achieves scores at or above the evaluated specialist reference on 20 of 28 settings and lower expected calibration error on 21 of 28. These improvements are accompanied by a 1.8 point decrease on the general Decision Index, regressions on two reasoning benchmarks, and increased calibration error on some settings. Our overall results characterize the benefits and limitations of EO adaptation while identifying quantitative perception, option-order consistency, and calibration under distribution shift as priorities for further study.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示d3-flash在几个构成的EO推理基准上表现良好,在80%的案例中(30个设置中有24个)实现了低于其主干线的预期校正误差. 它的主要弱点是计数、改变量化、损害分级和识别缺失对象。 EO适应在26个设置(86.7%的病例)上的性能显著改善,在适应期间使用的数据集的设置上,平均收益为++23.8%;在停放数据集的设置上,平均收益为++8.0分. EO-Jev在28个设置中的20个设置上达到或超过被评价的专家参考的分数,在28个设置中的21个设置了较低的预期校正误差. 在作出这些改进的同时,一般决策指数下降1.8分,两个推理基准出现倒退,一些设置的校正出错增加. 我们的总体成果将道德操守办公室适应的效益和局限性定性,同时确定定量感知、选择顺序一致性和分配转变下的校准是进一步研究的优先事项。

blocks.en: 2 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 2 评价设置

blocks.en: d3-flash ( vLLM Semantic Router Team, 2026 ) is the 8B member of vLLM Semantic Router’s Decision 3.0 family. It has 8.39B parameters including a 7.94B text tower, a 0.46B vision tower and a 1.04M-parameter readout. It is built on Qwen3.5-9B, a 32-layer hybrid of Gated DeltaNet and full-attention layers. Instead of a language-modelling head, it applies a 255 × 4096 255\times 4096 linear readout to the last prompt token, producing a distribution over up to 255 answer codes. A comparison of its weights with Qwen3.5-9B shows that the vision tower is frozen, the text tower fully fine-tuned, and the full-attention layers made bidirectional over the prompt. As a same-backbone control, we run Qwen3.5-9B through the same runtime with an identical prompt, image processing and answer codes, using its own language-head rows as the readout. Tokenizer, chat template and image processor are byte-identical, so differences between the two isolate decision training. For each benchmark, we select the open-weight EO specialist with the highest reported performance on the corresponding dataset (Table 2 ). Each selected specialist is evaluated on identical images, question wording and lettered options. We score both its option probabilities and generated answers, reporting the better result.
blocks.zh: d3-flash(vLLM语义路由器团队,2026年)是vLLM语义路由器决定3.0家族的8B成员. 它有8.39B参数,包括一个7.94B文本塔,一个0.46B视觉塔和一个1.04M参数读取. 它以Qwen3.5-9B为基础,由Gated DeltaNet和全心全意地层组成的32层混合体. 它不使用语言模版头,而是应用了255×4096 255\times 4096线性读取到最后一个快取符上,产生一个分布到最多255个回答代码. 其重量与Qwen3.5-9B的比较显示,视觉塔被冻结了,文本塔被完全微调,全心全意的地层被双向地对准了快取. 作为同一种后骨控制,我们用相同的即时,图像处理和回答代码运行了同一种运行时间的Quen3.5-9B,使用自己的语言头行作为读出. Tokenizer,聊天模板和图像处理器是字节-等同的,因此两个隔离决定训练的区别. 就每个基准而言,我们选择在相应数据集上报告业绩最高的开放加权道德操守办公室专家(表2)。 每个选定的专家都通过相同的图像、提问措辞和有字母的选项得到评价。 我们既得分了它的选择概率,又得出了答案,报告的结果更好。

blocks.en: Figure 2 summarizes how we adapt d3-flash to Earth observation. Training data (left): EO-Jev is trained on EO decision questions built only from public training splits, covering six families: scene and land-use labels, visual question answering, object counting, multi-temporal change, building damage and disaster type, and geo-localization. Every training image is checked against every evaluation image by perceptual hash, and fMoW training and evaluation images are additionally separated in time and space. To preserve general decision skills, about a fifth of every batch replays general decision data (text-only decision questions and natural-image multiple-choice questions) with d3-flash’s own probabilities as targets. Model (middle): EO-Jev adds low-rank adapters (LoRA) to the vision blocks (at a lower learning rate), the vision merger and the text tower of d3-flash, and keeps its 255-code readout. The loss matches the target distribution with a KL term, plus a ranked probability score for ordinal questions. Training runs for 20,000 steps, after which the adapters are merged into the BF16 weights, so EO-Jev has the same architecture and inference cost as d3-flash. Decisions (right): at inference, each typed question returns a probability distribution over its options in a single forward pass, and a per-question threshold decides whether to accept the answer or defer it to an analyst or a specialist model. Section 8 lists the training sources.
blocks.zh: 图2总结了我们如何将d3-闪电适应地球观测。 培训数据(左): EO-Jev只接受由公共培训分拆而成的EO决策问题的培训,涵盖6个家庭:场景和土地使用标签、视觉问题回答、物体计数、多时变化、建筑破坏和灾害类型以及地缘化。 每个培训图像都通过感知散列与每个评价图像相核对,fMOW培训和评价图像在时间和空间上额外分离. 为了保持一般的决策技能,每批中约有五分之一重播一般决策数据(仅文本的决定问题和自然图像多选择问题),d3-flash本身的概率作为目标. Model (Middle):EO-Jev在视觉块(以较低的学习速度),视觉并购和d3-flash的文本塔上添加了低等适配器(LORA)并保持了它的255码读取. 损失与目标分布相匹配的是 KL 术语, 加上平分问题排序的概率分数 。 训练会跑出2万步,之后适配器被合并为BF16重量,因此EO-Jev的建筑和推想成本与d3-flash相同. 决定 (正确):推断出,每个被打出的问题在一次前行传中返回其选项的概率分布,每个问题阈值决定是接受答案还是服从分析师还是专家模型. 第8节列出了培训来源。

blocks.en: The 30 evaluation settings fall into ten capability groups (Table 1 ). Multiple-choice benchmarks are used natively. Yes/no questions become binary decisions, and ordinal targets such as damage levels become ordered-level questions. Multi-select items are scored by exact-set match. We exclude SAR inputs throughout. Each setting is labelled in-domain if EO-Jev was trained on other images from the same dataset, and out-of-domain if no image from that dataset was used. In total, 18 settings are in-domain and 12 out-of-domain. Every training image was compared with every evaluation image by perceptual hash, so no evaluation image appears in training. For fMoW-WILDS, training and evaluation images are additionally separated in time and space.
blocks.zh: 30个评价设置分为10个能力组(表1)。 多种选择基准在本土使用。 是/没有问题成为二进制决定,损害程度等正统目标成为命令级问题. 多选项通过精确设置匹配来打入. 我们完全排除搜索和救援投入。 如果对EO-Jev进行了关于同一数据集其他图像的培训,如果未使用该数据集的图像,则每个设置都贴上域内标签;如果使用域外标记。 总共有18个设置是域内设置和12个域外设置. 每个培训图像都通过感知散列与每个评价图像进行比较,因此培训中没有出现评价图像。 对于fMOW-WILDS,培训和评价图像在时间和空间上额外分离.

blocks.en: We report accuracy, with three exceptions: exact-set match for multi-select settings, strict CircularEval accuracy for LHRS-Bench (correct under all four option orders), and correct abstention for VHM deceptive questions. Calibration is measured by expected calibration error (ECE) with 15 equal-width bins on the top answer’s probability. Differences between EO-Jev and d3-flash are tested with a paired 95% bootstrap over images. As a retention check, we also report the general (non-EO) Decision Index ( Decision Index contributors, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们报告准确性,除了三个例外:对多选设置的精确设置匹配,对LHRS-Bench的严格循环精度(在所有四个选项命令下正确),对VHM欺骗性问题的正确弃权. 校正用预期校正出错(ECE)来测量,顶端答案的概率上有15个等宽的弹箱. EO-Jev和d3-flash的区别用一对95%的靴子在图像上测试. 作为保留检查,我们还报告一般(非道德操守办公室)决定指数(决定指数贡献者,2026年).

blocks.en: 3 How Far Does a General Decision Model Reach on EO?
blocks.zh: 3 一般决定模式对道德操守办公室的影响如何?

blocks.en: RQ1 Which EO capabilities transfer from a general-purpose decision model without EO-specific adaptation, and how does its performance compare with EO specialists? TL;DR. Without any EO training, d3-flash barely matches or beats the best open EO specialist (7 of 28 settings). These settings test broad reasoning over varied imagery. Specialists lead wherever they were trained on the benchmark, and both d3-flash and its backbone are weak on quantitative perception and abstention.
blocks.zh: 问题1 哪些业务主管能力从普通用途决策模式中转移而无需对业务主管进行具体调整,其业绩如何与业务主管专家进行比较? TL; DR. (英语). 没有任何EO训练,d3-flash几乎无法匹配或击败最佳开放EO专家(28个设置中的7个). 这些设置检验了各种图像的广泛推理。 专家在接受基准培训的任何地方都处于领先地位,d3-flash及其骨干在数量认知和弃权方面都软弱无力。

blocks.en: The clearest strength of the zero-shot model is broad multiple-choice reasoning over EO imagery. (i) On LHRS-Bench under strict CircularEval it reaches 77.5, against 60.0 for the best specialist. On CHOICE, whose imagery was collected after most current models were trained, it reaches 83.5 against 76.9. (ii) It also leads on UrBench geo-localisation (60.3 vs. 55.6), on DisasterM3 (46.2 vs. 38.0 single-choice; 23.3 vs. 6.9 multi-select), on EarthMind optical (67.5 vs. 66.6) and on VHM honest questions (71.3 vs. 67.8). (iii) It is roughly tied with GeoZero on GEOBench-VLM (51.9 vs. 52.3) and with GeoChrono on CDVQA (43.9 vs. 45.7). Most of these benchmarks lie outside the specialists’ training data, so they measure transfer rather than fit.
blocks.zh: 零射出模型最明显的强点是比EO图像的广义多选择推理. (一) 在严格通知Eval规定的LHRS-Bench上,最优秀的专家达到77.5人,而最优秀的专家为60.0人。 在CHOICE上,其图像是经过大多数现有模型培训后收集的,达到了83.5对76.9。 (二)它还领导Ur Bench地理定位(60.3 vs 55.6),灾害M3(46.2 vs 38.0 单选;23.3 vs 6.9 多选),地球明德光学(67.5 vs 66.6)和VHM诚实问题(71.3 vs 67.8)。 (三) 在GEO Bench-VLM(51.9起对52.3起)和CDVQA(43.9起对45.7起)上大致与GeoZero捆绑在一起。 这些基准大多在专家培训数据之外,因此它们衡量的是转让,而不是合适的。

blocks.en: d3-flash trails specialists trained on the corresponding benchmarks, particularly in scene classification and visual question answering. On AID and NWPU-RESISC45, RSThinker achieves 98.5 and 97.0, respectively, compared with 78.1 and 73.3 for d3-flash. On RSVQA, GeoZero and EarthDial outperform d3-flash by 18.6 and 16.8 percentage points. Performance is also weak on low-resolution images and classification tasks with many classes, reaching only 57.3 on 64 2 64^{2} -pixel EuroSAT tiles and 26.0 on 62-class fMoW facility classification.
blocks.zh: d3-闪光追踪专家接受相应基准的培训,特别是在现场分类和视觉问题回答方面。 在AID和NWPU-RESISC45上,RSTHinker分别实现98.5和97.0,而d3-flash则达到78.1和73.3. 在RSVQA上,GeoZero和EarthDial的性能比d3-flash高出了18.6%和16.8%. 低分辨率图像和分类任务的表现也很薄弱,有多个类,在64 2 64\\2}只达到57.3 -pixel EuroSAT瓦和26.0在62级fMOW设施分类上.

blocks.en: These tasks expose several of d3-flash’s main limitations. Counting accuracy is 33.8 on DOTA-v2 and 64.2 on NWPU VHR-10. For change detection, the model can identify whether a change has occurred, but struggles to quantify the type of change: on CDVQA, it answers “buildings” for 401 of 468 questions asking which class changed most, regardless of the image. On xBD, damage classification accuracy is 41.1, compared with a chance level of 25.0. On DVL-Bench, exact-set accuracy for multi-temporal multi-select questions is just 13.1. Finally, on VHM questions designed to test whether the model recognizes absent objects, it abstains correctly only 30.4% of the time, below the 33.9% achieved by its Qwen3.5-9B backbone.
blocks.zh: 这些任务暴露出d3-flash的几个主要局限性. DOTA-v2上的计数精度为33.8,NWPU VHR-10上的计数精度为64.2. 对于变化检测,模型可以识别是否发生了变化,但为量化变化类型而挣扎:在CDVQA上,它回答468个问题中的401个问题的"构建",询问哪个类别变化最大,无论图像如何. 在xBD上,破坏分类精度为41.1,而概率为25.0. 在DVL-Bench上,多时多选题的精确设定精度仅为13.1. 最后,关于旨在测试该模型是否承认缺失对象的VHM问题,它只正确弃权时间的30.4%,低于其Quen3.5-9B主干线实现的33.9%.

blocks.en:
Compared with its Qwen3.5-9B backbone evaluated using an equivalent answer-code readout, d3-flash achieves higher accuracy in 23 of 30 settings, although the gains are generally modest. This suggests that most of its EO perception capabilities are inherited from the backbone. The largest improvements occur in geo-localization, with gains of 14.0 percentage points on fMoW-WILDS country classification and 11.0 on UrBench, and in option-order robustness, with a 7.5-point gain in strict LHRS-Bench accuracy. In earlier zero-shot experiments, decision training also reduced the proportion of GEOBench-VLM answers that changed when the options were reordered, from 40.9% to 13.5%. The clearest benefit is improved confidence calibration where d3-flash achieves lower ECE than its backbone in 24 of 30 settings.
(Section 5 ).
blocks.zh:
与其使用等同的解码读取方式评价的Quen3.5-9B主干线相比,d3-flash在30个设置中的23个实现更高的精度,尽管收益一般是微小的. 这表明其大部分EO感知能力都是从骨干上继承而来. 最大的改进发生在地缘本地化方面,fMOW-WILDS国家分级收益为14.0个百分点,Ur Bench为11.0个百分点;在选项顺序稳健方面,严格LHRS-Bench精度收益为7.5个百分点. 在较早的零镜头实验中,决策培训还把GEO Bench-VLM答案在重新排序时变化的比例从40.9%降低到13.5%。 最明显的好处是改进了信心校准,在30个环境中,d3-flash在24个环境中实现的欧洲经委会低于其骨干。
(第5节)

blocks.en: A general decision model already brings two things EO specialists lack. First, compositional reasoning that transfers to new benchmarks, and second, calibrated probabilities. It lacks the quantitative, EO-specific perception that specialists acquire from in-domain training.
blocks.zh: 一个一般的决策模式已经带来了道德操守办公室专家缺乏的两个方面。 第一,向新基准转移的构成推理,第二,调整概率。 它缺乏一种量化的、针对道德操守办公室的观念,即专家从内部培训中获得。

blocks.zh: 4 道德操守办公室监督员增加哪些内容?

blocks.en: RQ2 How does EO supervision affect performance, and do its benefits extend to datasets held out from adaptation? TL;DR. EO supervision improves EO-Jev significantly on 26 of 30 settings: by + 23.8 +23.8 points on average in-domain and + 8.0 +8.0 out-of-domain. Under equal supervision, the single model matches or beats the specialists on 20 of 28 settings. The costs are small regressions on two option-order-sensitive reasoning benchmarks and 1.8 points of general decision skill.
blocks.zh: 问题2 道德操守办公室的监督如何影响业绩,其好处是否扩大到适应过程中的数据集? TL; DR. EO监督在30个设置中的26个设置上显著地改进了EO-Jev:平均内域分+23.8+23.8分,外域分+8.0+8.0分. 在平等监督下,单一型号在28个设置中的20个设置上匹配或战胜了专家. 成本是对两个选择顺序敏感推理基准和1.8分一般决策技能的小回归.

blocks.en: All 18 in-domain settings improve significantly, by + 23.8 +23.8 points on average (median + 24.6 +24.6 ). Examples include DisasterM3 single-choice ( 46.2 → 91.1 46.2\rightarrow 91.1 ), EuroSAT ( 57.3 → 96.1 57.3\rightarrow 96.1 ), DisasterM3 multi-select ( 23.3 → 58.8 23.3\rightarrow 58.8 ), DVL-Bench, CDVQA, RSVQA-LR and fMoW-WILDS country (each + 25 +25 to + 26 +26 ), xBD damage grading ( 41.1 → 65.1 41.1\rightarrow 65.1 ) and xBD disaster type ( 70.0 → 95.1 70.0\rightarrow 95.1 ). The fMoW gains show that this is not memorization: training images predate 2013, evaluation images date from 2016 onwards, and training images near any evaluation site are removed, yet country accuracy rises from 44.4 to 70.3.
blocks.zh: 所有18个域内设置均显著改善,平均比分为+23.8+23.8分(中位数+24.6+24.6). 例如:灾害M3单项选择(46.2-91.1 46.2-右翼91.1),欧洲卫星(57.3-96.1 57.3-右翼96.1),灾害M3多选取(23.3-58.8 23.3-右翼58.8),DVL-Bench,CDVQA,RSVQA-LR和fMOW-WILDS国家(每个+25+25至+26+26),xBD损害分级(41.1-65.1-右翼65.1)和xBD灾害类型(70.0-95.1 70.0-右翼95.1)。 fMOW的成绩表明这不是纪念:培训图像在2013年之前,评价图像从2016年开始,任何评价站点附近的培训图像都被删除,但国家准确度从44.4提高到70.3。

blocks.en: Of the 12 out-of-domain settings, 8 improve significantly, by + 8.0 +8.0 points on average across all 12. Transfer is strongest when an unseen benchmark shares a task with the training data. (i) Scene datasets never used in training improve by 6 to 11 points: UC Merced + 11.0 +11.0 , SIRI-WHU + 7.7 +7.7 , WHU-RS19 + 6.2 +6.2 . (ii) GEOBench-VLM improves by + 9.8 +9.8 and NWPU VHR-10 counting by + 7.8 +7.8 . (iii) The largest out-of-domain gain is in abstention: correct abstention on VHM deceptive questions rises from 30.4 to 74.0 even though no VHM data was used, because training on questions about absent objects in other datasets generalizes.
blocks.zh: 在12个域外设置中,有8个显著改善,在所有12个域外设置中,平均+8.0+8.0分. 当一个看不见的基准与培训数据分担一项任务时,转让最强。 (一) 培训中从未使用过的场景数据集改进了6至11分: UC Merced + 11.0 + 11.0,SIRI-WHU + 7.7 + 7.7,WHU-RS19 + 6.2 + 6.2 (二) GEO Bench-VLM 改进了 + 9.8 + 9.8,NWPU VHR-10 计数 + 7.8 + 7.8 → (三) 最大的域外收益是弃权: VHM 欺骗性问题的正确弃权率从 30.4 升至 74.0,尽管没有使用 VHM 数据,因为对其他数据集中缺失对象问题的培训被概括化.

blocks.en: EO-Jev matches or exceeds the best specialist on 20 of 28 settings, and on 14 of the 17 in-domain settings that have one. In most of these comparisons the specialist was also trained on the benchmark’s own split, so the comparison is between equally supervised models. Where specialists remain ahead, the margin is under 2 points except on NWPU VHR-10 counting ( − 7.8 -7.8 ): UC Merced − 0.3 -0.3 , AID − 0.7 -0.7 , WHU-RS19 − 1.4 -1.4 , SIRI-WHU − 0.2 -0.2 , NWPU-RESISC45 − 1.8 -1.8 , DOTA-v2 − 0.6 -0.6 and VHM deceptive − 0.7 -0.7 . The largest leads are on tasks where specialists generalize poorly: DisasterM3 ( + 53.1 +53.1 and + 51.9 +51.9 over TerraScope), CDVQA ( + 23.5 +23.5 ) and DVL-Bench ( + 21.7 +21.7 ) over GeoChrono, fMoW-WILDS country ( + 20.7 +20.7 ) over Geo-R1, EuroSAT ( + 18.4 +18.4 ) and xBD damage ( + 16.7 +16.7 ).
blocks.zh: EO-Jev在28个设置中的20个和拥有一个的17个域内设置中的14个匹配或超过最佳专家. 在大多数这些比较中,专家还接受了关于基准本身的分法的培训,因此比较是在同样受到监督的模型之间进行的。 在专家领先的情况下,比值低于2分,但NWPU VHR-10计数(−7.8-7.8):UC Merced−0.3-0.3,AID−0.7-0.7,WHU-RS19−1.4,SIRI-WHU−0.2-0.2,NWPU-RESISC45−1.8-1.8,DOTA-v2−0.6-0.6和VHM欺骗−0.7-0.7。 最大的线索是专家一般不擅长的任务:灾害M3(+53.1+53.1和+51.9+51.9飞越TerraScope)、CDVQA(+23.5+23.5)和DVL-Bench(+21.7+21.7)飞越GeoChrono、fMOW-WILDS国家(+20.7+20.7)飞越Geo-R1、EuroSAT(+18.4+18.4)和xBD损坏(+16.7+16.7)。

blocks.en: Four out-of-domain settings do not show a statistically significant improvement.. CHOICE ( − 1.5 -1.5 ) and LHRS-Bench strict ( − 5.2 -5.2 ) decrease significantly, though both remain well above every specialist. UrBench ( + 1.2 +1.2 ) and absent-class questions ( + 4.7 +4.7 ) change insignificantly. All four test broad reasoning or robustness rather than one perceptual skill. LHRS-Bench strict accuracy requires a correct answer under every option order, so its decrease points to a slight erosion of the option-order consistency that decision training provides. On the general Decision Index, EO-Jev scores 91.9 against 93.7 for d3-flash, a drop of 1.8 points.
blocks.zh: 四个域外设置在统计学上没有显著改善. CHOICE(− 1.5-1.5)和LHRS-Bench严格(− 5.2-5.2)大幅下降,尽管两者都远远高于每个专家。 Ur Bench (+ 1.2 + 1.2)和缺席类问题 (+ 4.7 + 4.7) 变化不大. 这四个测试的是广义的推理或稳健性,而不是一种感官技能. LHRS-Bench严格准确性要求在每个选项顺序下有一个正确的答案,因此其下降表明决策培训提供的选项-顺序一致性略有削弱. 在总决策指数上,EO-Jev对d3-flash的分数是91.9分,比93.7分,下降了1.8分.

blocks.en: EO supervision converts a general decision model into one that rivals specialists across tasks, and its gains reach well beyond the datasets it was trained on. The specialists’ edge was supervision rather than architecture: once the general model receives comparable supervision, the edge largely disappears. Figure 3 shows one example per capability group, including two out-of-domain cases (counting on NWPU VHR-10 and abstention on VHM deceptive questions) that EO-Jev answers correctly while d3-flash does not.
blocks.zh: 道德操守办公室的监督将一般决策模式转换为与不同任务的专家竞争的模式,其成果远远超出其所培训的数据集。 专家的边缘是监督而不是建筑:一旦一般模型得到可比的监督,边缘基本上就消失了。 图3显示每个能力组一个实例,包括两个领域外案例(计算NWPU VHR-10和对VHM欺骗性问题的弃权),EO-Jev给出正确答案,而d3-flash没有给出正确答案.

blocks.en: 5 Can the Model’s Confidence Be Trusted, and at What Cost?
blocks.zh: 5 能否信任模式的信任,以何种代价?

blocks.en: RQ3 How do calibration and inference cost compare with the backbone and specialist baselines? TL;DR. EO-Jev has lower ECE than d3-flash on 20 of 30 settings, including significant reductions on 17 than its backbone on 27 of 30 and than the best specialist on 21 of 28. Where calibration worsens, the cause is systematic over-confidence. Answering in one forward pass, EO-Jev is a median 6.4 × \times faster than the best specialist.
blocks.zh: 问题3 校准和推断费用如何与主干线和专家基线相比较? TL; DR. EO-Jev在30个设置中,有20个设置的ECE低于d3-flash,其中17个设置比其骨干在30个设置中的27个显著减少,28个设置中21个设置比最佳专家减少。 在校正恶化的地方,原因是系统性的过度自信. EO-Jev在一次前行中回答时的中位数6.4×\时速快于最佳专家.

blocks.en: ECE is measured over the same questions for every model; multi-select options count as binary questions. As Figure 4 shows, EO-Jev has significantly lower ECE than d3-flash on 17 of 30 EO settings, higher on 5, and no significant change on 8. The largest improvements are on settings where d3-flash was both inaccurate and over-confident. ECE on VHM deceptive questions falls from 0.254 to 0.062, xBD damage grading from 0.168 to 0.050, and WHU-RS19 from 0.105 to 0.009. On in-domain scene and VQA settings, EO-Jev’s ECE is typically 0.01–0.03.
blocks.zh: 欧洲经委会按每个模型的相同问题衡量;多选择选项算作二进制问题。 如图4所显示的,EO-Jev在30个EO设置中,有17个比d3-flash低很多,在5个设置中较高,在8个设置上没有重大变化. 最大的改进是在d3-flash既不准确又过于自信的设置上. 欧洲经委会关于VHM的欺骗性问题从0.254降至0.062,xBD损害从0.168降至0.050,WHU-RS19从0.105降至0.009。 在域内场景和VQA设置中,EO-Jev的ECE一般为0.01-0.03.

blocks.en: We evaluate specialists using their option-probability outputs because their generated answers do not provide confidence estimates. EO-Jev achieves lower ECE than the best specialist in 21 of 28 settings and lower ECE than Qwen3.5-9B in 27 of 30. Specialist calibration is competitive on scene classification, where RSThinker achieves ECE values between 0.004 and 0.052. However, calibration is much worse on counting and multi-select tasks. RSThinker reaches an ECE of 0.712 on NWPU VHR-10 and 0.356 on DOTA-v2, while TerraScope reaches 0.529 on DisasterM3 multi-select. In these settings, specialist confidence is a poor indicator of whether an answer is correct.
blocks.zh: 我们利用专家的可选择性产出来评价他们,因为他们生成的答案没有提供信心估计。 EO-Jev在28个环境中有21个实现了欧洲经委会低于最佳专家,在30个环境中有27个实现了欧洲经委会低于Quen3.5-9B。 专家校准在现场分类上具有竞争力,RSTHINKER在现场分类中达到ECE值为0.004至0.052. 然而,在计数和多选取任务上,校正更糟糕. RSTHinker在NWPU VHR-10和DOTA-v2上达到0.712的ECE,而TerraScope在DiskM3上达到0.529的多选取. 在这些环境下,专家信心是衡量答案是否正确的一个差指标.

blocks.en: Whenever EO-Jev is significantly less calibrated than d3-flash on an EO setting, its mean confidence exceeds its accuracy. This gap reaches 12–14 percentage points on SIRI-WHU, GEOBench-VLM, and fMoW-WILDS continent. It is also 7.3 points on VHM honest questions and 6.2 points on BigEarthNet. The latter two results are associated with a tendency to answer “yes” to questions about object presence. Since these errors reflect systematic overconfidence rather than random variation, per-task temperature scaling fitted on a development set may correct much of the miscalibration. We leave this evaluation for future work.
blocks.zh: 每当EO-Jev在EO设置上的校正分量明显低于d3-flash时,其平均置信度会超过其准确度. 这一差距在SIRI-WHU,GEO Bench-VLM和fMOW-WILDS大陆上达到12–14个百分点. 它在VHM诚实问题上也是7.3分,在BigEarthNet上也是6.2分. 后两项结果与对物体存在问题回答“是”的倾向有关。 由于这些错误反映的是系统性的过度自信,而不是随机的变异,因此安装在开发集上的每个任务温度缩放可能会纠正大部分的校正错误. 我们把这一评价留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: With one question per call, EO-Jev is a median 3.2 × \times faster than the best specialist (range 0.8–109 × \times ); the specialist is faster on 7 of 28 rows and ties on one. With batching the median rises to 6.4 × \times (range 0.8–41 × \times ), and the specialist is faster on only 3 rows (See Figure 5 . The large gains come almost entirely from generative specialists that must decode an answer. Against prompted VLMs of similar size (RSVQA, DVL-Bench, fMoW-WILDS, CHOICE), EO-Jev costs about the same, since both run one forward pass. The speed advantage is therefore structural: it comes from reading out a decision instead of generating one, not from a smaller model.
blocks.zh: EO-Jev每通电话就有一个问题,其中位数3.2×x\时速快于最优秀的专家(范围为0.8-109×;专家在28行中的7行和一行的领带上速度快. 随着分批的中位数上升至 6.4 ×\时(范围为 0.8–41 ×\时),专家在只3行上的速度更快(见图5). 巨额收益几乎全部来自基因专家,他们必须解码答案。 EO-Jev对大小相近(RSVQA、DVL-Bench、fMOW-WILDS、CHOICE)的诱发的VLM费用大致相同,因为两者都通过一次前行。 因此速度优势是结构性的:它来自宣读一个决定而不是生成一个,而不是从一个更小的模型.

blocks.en: Decision models provide a practical combination of calibrated confidence and low inference cost for automated EO pipelines. They produce answers in a single forward pass, while specialists that generate written answers are several times slower. Specialists evaluated through option probabilities can match this speed, but their confidence is often poorly calibrated, particularly on counting and multi-select tasks.
blocks.zh: 决策模型为自动化的EO管线提供了校准置信和低推论成本的实际结合. 它们以一个单一的前进通道生成答案,而生成书面答案的专家则会慢出数倍. 通过选项概率评价的专家可以匹配这个速度,但他们的信心往往不准确校正,尤其是关于计数和多选任务.

blocks.en: 6 What Remains Hard?
blocks.zh: 6 还有什么难的?

blocks.en: RQ4 Which limitations persist after decision model adaptation to EO tasks? TL;DR. The remaining gaps are counting on unseen imagery, robustness to option order, geometric and cross-view reasoning, and calibration far from the training data. Zero-shot diagnostics show that recognition failures were mostly a readout problem, which adaptation fixed, while quantitative failures reflect missing perception.
blocks.zh: 问题4 在决策模式适应道德操守办公室任务之后,哪些限制仍然存在? TL; DR. (英语). 其余的空白取决于未见图像、稳健度到选项顺序、几何和交叉视图推理以及远离培训数据的校正。 零镜头诊断表明,识别失败大多是一个读出问题,适应性固定了,而量化失败则反映了缺失的认知.

blocks.en: Counting is the only capability where a specialist still leads clearly. On out-of-domain NWPU VHR-10, EO-Jev improves from 64.2 to 72.0 but trails RSThinker by 7.8 points. On in-domain DOTA-v2 it reaches 47.7, within 0.6 points of RSThinker, but absolute accuracy remains low for every model. Zero-shot, extra resolution helped counting slightly: tiling ultra-high-resolution scenes improved counting by 5.0 points. Counting therefore appears limited by perception at the 1.6 MP input budget as well as by supervision.
blocks.zh: 数数是专家仍能明显领导的唯一能力。 在外域NWPU VHR-10上,EO-Jev的成绩由64.2提高到72.0,但追平了RSTHinker7.8分. 在域内DOTA-v2上,在RSThinker的0.6分以内达到47.7分,但每个模型的绝对精度仍然很低. 零射出,额外解析度帮助了略微计数:平地平地超高分场景的计数提高了5.0分. 因此,在1.6议员投入预算以及监督方面,计算似乎受到限制。

blocks.en: d3-flash’s decision training made it far more stable under option reordering than its backbone. Adaptation slightly erodes this: CHOICE drops by 1.5 points and LHRS-Bench strict accuracy by 5.2. Training with option-permutation augmentation, and keeping option-order tests as regression checks, is the obvious remedy.
blocks.zh: d3-flash 的决定培训使其在选项重排时比其主干线稳定得多。 适应略微侵蚀了这一点:CHOICE下降1.5分,LHRS-Bench严格精度下降5.2分. 以选择式增量培训以及将选择式测试作为回归检查是明显的补救办法。

blocks.en: UrBench does not change significantly with adaptation ( 60.3 → 61.5 60.3\rightarrow 61.5 ). Zero-shot, its orientation-estimation questions were near chance (30.5 against a 24% random baseline). Our training data contains no cross-view supervision. Zero-shot diagnostics also show orientation sensitivity on single images: about a fifth of correct scene and GEOBench-VLM answers change under some rotation, even though nadir imagery has no canonical up direction.
blocks.zh: Ur Bench没有随着适应(60.3 – 61.5 60.3\正弦61.5 ) 发生重大变化。 0射出,它的定向估计问题几乎是偶然的(30.5对24%的随机基线). 我们的训练数据没有交叉视野监控 零镜头诊断在单个图像上也显示出定向敏感性:大约五分之一的正确场景和GEO Bench-VLM在一定旋转下回答变化,尽管nadir图像没有卡通向上的方向.

blocks.en: The settings where EO-Jev becomes over-confident (SIRI-WHU, GEOBench-VLM, fMoW-WILDS continent, VHM honest questions) are mostly out-of-domain, or involve label sets with many similar classes. Adaptation sharpens the output distributions everywhere, but accuracy improves less out of domain.
blocks.zh: EO-Jev变得过度自信的设置(SIRI-WHU,GEO Bench-VLM,fMOW-WILDS大陆,VHM诚实问题)大多是域外设置,或涉及与许多相类似类的标签套. 适应使各地的输出分布更加清晰,但准确性改善较少出自域外.

blocks.en: Zero-shot probes explain why recognition responds so well to adaptation. A linear probe on d3-flash’s decision state, the hidden state its readout scores, reaches 96.4, 94.3 and 87.5 on AID, EuroSAT and NWPU-RESISC45, where its zero-shot answers reach 78.1, 56.8 and 73.5. The information needed to recognise the scene was already present but not mapped to the right label. Adaptation recovers almost exactly this gap: EO-Jev reaches 97.8, 96.1 and 95.2 on the evaluation sets of the same datasets. Counting and change quantification were weak in both the zero-shot model and its backbone, and they improve less. This suggests that these skills need new perceptual supervision, not only a better readout.
blocks.zh: 零镜头探测器解释了为什么识别对适应反应那么好. d3-flash决定状态的线性探测器,即隐藏状态的读取分数,在AID,EuroSAT和NWPU-RESISC45上达到96.4,94.3和87.5分,其零发答数达到78.1,56.8和73.5分. 识别现场所需的信息已经存在,但没有映射到正确的标签上。 适应几乎完全弥补了这一差距:EO-Jev在同一数据集的评价组上达到97.8、96.1和95.2。 计数和变化量化在"零射"模型及其主干上都比较薄弱,而且改善较少. 这表明这些技能需要新的观念监督,而不仅仅是更好的阅读。

blocks.en: 7 Where Does a Decision Model Stand on EO?
blocks.zh: 7 道德操守办公室的决定模式在哪里?

blocks.en: Figure 6 summarizes where EO-Jev stands relative to the strongest available open EO specialist on each setting. Fifteen settings exceed specialist level by more than 10%. They are dominated by tasks where specialists generalize poorly or were trained for a different question format: disaster assessment, change and temporal reasoning, geo-localization and fine-grained recognition. Five more are at specialist level. The remaining eight are approaching it, all within 2% except NWPU VHR-10 counting (90%). They comprise five scene datasets, two counting settings, and deceptive-question abstention, where VHM-7B was trained for exactly that task. No setting shows a substantial gap.
blocks.zh: 图6概述了EO-Jev相对于每个环境上最强的开放的EO专家所处的位置。 15个设置超过专家水平超过10%。 这些任务主要是专家一般情况不佳或接受不同问题形式的培训:灾害评估、变化和时间推理、地缘定位和精细识别。 还有五个是专家级的。 其余8个正在接近,除NWPU VHR-10计数(90%)外,其余都在2%以内。 它们包括五个场景数据集、两个计数设置和欺骗性提问弃权,VHM-7B在那里接受了精确的训练。 没有设置显示存在很大差距。

blocks.en: These results suggest a practical division of labor. A single calibrated decision model can serve as the default interface for EO decisions: one forward pass per question, confidence that supports thresholding and deferral, and accuracy at or above specialist level on most tasks. Specialist models remain valuable where a task needs perception the decision model has not learned, such as counting on unfamiliar imagery, and where their generated explanations matter more than calibrated confidence. Because a decision model’s errors come with confidence, a pipeline can route its uncertain cases to specialists or analysts rather than replace either.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明实际分工。 单一的校正式决定模型可以作为道德操守办公室决定的默认接口:每个问题一个前传,支持阈值和延后的信任,以及大多数任务在专家一级或以上准确性。 在一项任务需要理解决策模式尚未掌握的情况下,如依靠不熟悉的图像,以及其生成的解释比校准的信心更重要的情况下,专家模型仍然具有价值。 由于决策模式的错误充满信心,管道可以将其不确定的情况交给专家或分析人员,而不是替代。

blocks.en: d3-flash, Qwen3.5-9B and EO-Jev return a probability for every option; the prediction is the most probable option. Every specialist sees the same question text, built from our converted rows; only its chat template differs. In option-probability mode, a specialist’s answer is pre-filled up to where it writes the option, and each option’s probability is read from the next-token distribution. In generation mode, the specialist decodes greedily in its own reasoning format and the answer is mapped to an option. Before trusting a specialist’s scores, we reproduced one of its published numbers where our protocol matches the original.

blocks.en: Training examples are drawn exclusively from public training splits, with all evaluation images removed to prevent data leakage. For scene classification and land-use mapping, we use AID images outside the evaluation list, the EuroSAT and BigEarthNet v2 training splits, and fMoW-WILDS training images acquired before 2013 and located away from evaluation sites. Object and building counting examples come from DOTA-v2 training tiles, excluding the validation split, and building counts derived from xBD pre-disaster footprints. Damage assessment and disaster-type classification examples are drawn from the xBD train and tier3 splits. For general EO reasoning, we use the training splits of NWPU-RESISC45, RSVQA, VRSBench, CDVQA, DisasterM3, and DVL-Bench. Finally, general decision-making is supported by text-only decision questions and natural-image multiple-choice questions, using d3-flash’s own probabilities as training targets.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: We studied decision models for earth observation through a diagnostic evaluation across 30 settings from 23 public benchmarks, followed by EO-specific adaptation. The evaluation shows that d3-flash transfers well to several compositional reasoning tasks and generally improves calibration over its backbone, but remains limited in counting, change quantification, damage grading, and recognizing absent objects. Our proposed adaptation approach yields EO-Jev, which improves significantly on 26 settings and achieves scores at or above the evaluated specialist reference on 20 of 28. Its average gain of 8.0 percentage points across 12 settings held out from adaptation demonstrates that the benefits extend beyond the training datasets. EO-Jev also achieves lower expected calibration error than specialist references on 21 of 28 settings while retaining single-pass prediction without autoregressive decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对23个公共基准的30个环境进行诊断性评价,研究了地球观测决策模型,随后进行了针对地球环境的适应。 评估显示,d3-flash很好地转移了几个组成推理任务,总体上改善了主干线的校正,但在计数、改变量化、损害分级和识别缺失对象方面仍然有限。 我们提议的适应方法使EO-Jev在26个设置上大有改进,在28个设置中达到或超过评估的专家参考的分数。 它在12个适应环境中的平均收益为8.0个百分点,表明其效益超出了培训数据集。 EO-Jev在28个设置中的21个设置上也实现了低于专家引用的预期校正误差,同时保留了单通预测而无需自旋解码.

blocks.en: These gains come with trade-offs. Adaptation reduces general decision performance by a small margin of 1.8 points, lowers accuracy on two reasoning benchmarks, and increases calibration error on some settings. Counting on unfamiliar imagery and geometric reasoning also remain difficult. The findings support decision models as an efficient, shared interface for diverse EO tasks, while showing that accuracy, calibration, and robustness must be assessed separately. Further progress requires stronger quantitative and geometric perception, consistency under option reordering, and evaluation of confidence-based deferral under distribution shift. Beyond standalone prediction, integrating calibrated decision models into agentic EO pipelines offers a promising direction for building systems that can reason across tasks while identifying when their predictions require further verification.
